we developed the capabilities for analysis of fully coupled fluid flows and structural interaction, including incompressible Navier-Stokes and compressible Euler and Navier-Stokes fluids, large structural deformations, large rotations, nonlinear materials, contact conditions, and computer-aided modeling.

the development of a computational fluid dynamics capability in the ADINA finite element program for the solution of fluid flows coupled with structural interactions.
the analysis of fluid flows that are fully coupled with structural deformations.
